See TS_I_COVER_PURCHASE | 2026-10-15: filled from official static pricing article. Monthly list prices: 50K Std $49 / NAF $95; 100K Std $99 / NAF $149; 150K NAF $229. 150K_STD key intentionally absent (CONFLICT, see TS_NEW_PRICE_STD_150000_MONTHLY / TS_I_PRICE_150K). NAF + DLL at purchase gets Responsible Trading discount (TS_NEW_RTD_DISCOUNT; e.g. 50K −$10) — the $85 configurator display is NOT confirmed (needs browser check). rules.applicability: {"configuration":"Express Funded Account (Standard and Consistency payout paths), all six Combine plans; official public pages only","account_agreement":"DOCUMENT_NOT_RETRIEVED (XFA Agreement is presented in the logged-in activation flow; not read)"}
rules.notes: Standard §4 required item; not sufficiently established by retrieved sources for this configuration family. See TS_I_COVER_PAYOUT | 2026-10-18: UNKNOWN → NOT_PUBLISHED. No official public page read on 2026-10-18 states a maximum number of XFA payouts, a payout count that ends the XFA, or a payout count that forces a move to Live. Published payout limits are per request only (50% of balance up to the size/path cap: TS_PO03, TS_PO07_*, TS_PO08_*, TS_PO09). Call Up FAQ: 5 payouts are NOT required to move to Live — the decision is a Risk Team review (TS_NEW_GAP_LIVE_REVIEW_review_trigger). value=null means not published (not 0, not unlimited). The Express Funded Account Agreement is DOCUMENT_NOT_RETRIEVED (login-only), so a count limit in the agreement cannot be ruled out — TS_I_XFA_AGREEMENT_20261018. Third-party mentions of '5 payouts' were search leads only, not evidence. | 2026-10-26: Call-up FAQ (updated 2026-10-23) now also says more XFA payouts make a Live review more likely; still no payout count required (TS_NEW_GAP_LIVE_REVIEW_review_trigger).

rules.applicability: {"configuration":"150K Trading Combine, Standard path, per month"}
rules.notes: 2026-10-15: official sources disagree for the same scope (current 150K Trading Combine, Standard path monthly price): help article says $199/month (corroborated by topstep-prop card attribute standard-price=199, JS-only), products.topstep.com says $149 (bundle record; earlier rendered '$149 USD/month'). Same product family and billing period; the products page's 50K/100K prices match the Standard path ($49/$99), so scopes overlap → CONFLICT, value null, no selection. See TS_I_PRICE_150K. | 2026-10-15: both sides now browser-confirmed: topstep-prop Standard $150K $199/month vs products.topstep.com $150k $149 USD/month (14:55 PT). The products page shows no path; its 50K/100K ($49/$99) equal the Standard path, so scopes still overlap → CONFLICT kept, no selection. Checkout not opened. unit USD / currency USD (upgraded from USD_PRESUMED_UNCONFIRMED): the same amounts are displayed on official pages with an explicit ISO code — products.topstep.com '$49 / $99 / $149 USD/month' and topstep-prop with 'Select currency: USD' (browser check 2026-10-15). Standard col 34 requires an explicit ISO 4217 code and col 13 forbids deciding the unit from display format alone; both conditions are now met for the display currency. Checkout/charge currency was not observed (checkout needs an account), see TS_NEW_GAP_PURCHASE_purchase_currency. | 2026-10-26: RESOLVED to $199 (CONFLICT -> VERIFIED, scope = topstep-prop Standard path configurator and help article 14289835 Standard Path column). Live read ~15:55-16:00 PT: Standard tab 150K $199/month with RTA Off and RTA On; $149 appears on the live topstep-prop page only as the Standard Express Funded Activation Fee (all sizes) and as the 100K No Activation Fee RTA Off price. Evidence strength: PAGE_TEXT_ONLY for 2026-10-26 (weaker; no screenshot of the Standard tab), plus the 2026-10-15 screenshots and help-article quote. The earlier candidate $149 (products.topstep.com, no path/RTA label; TS_S20_20261015, TS_SCR_PRODUCTS_20261015, TS_S_PRODUCTS_20261026) is kept in conflict_candidates for history but is NOT explained by the live evidence; the issue stays PARTIALLY_RESOLVED. Checkout total not observed.
rules.source_locator: topstep-prop Standard tab, card $150K Buying Power monthly price (2026-10-15 and 2026-10-26 browser reads); help 14289835 Trading Combine table row 150K Standard; products.topstep.com $150k record kept as unresolved residual

'$' only → USD_PRESUMED_UNCONFIRMED. | 2026-10-15: verbatim quotes added ('$10 off → 50K | $20 off → 100K | $30 off → 150K'; condition and monthly recurrence). Browser NAF + RTA On: $85 ($95 struck, 'Discount: -$10' in page text), $129 ($149 struck, −$20), $199 ($229 struck, 'Discount: -$30'); badge 'Save up to $30/month'. The configurator names the DLL option 'Responsible Trading Advantage'. source_records.title: Prohibited Conduct
